task: MR12 补测：出站出口审计与"不得绕过策略"守卫（A8）
closes: gap-register A8 (the icon/update-path rate-limit audit that MR12 left undone)

auditConclusions.curseForge: all 3 CF API request sites are inside CurseForgeRequestPolicy.SendAsync (lines 339/380/430 each preceded by the policy call); the policy still enforces a SemaphoreSlim concurrency cap and Retry-After
auditConclusions.icons: ContentIconService contains NO CF/Modrinth API literal. Icons fetch media URLs from a server-built trusted URL map (LocalApiService only accepts a (source, category, projectId) triple and never a client-supplied URL), so the icon path CANNOT bypass the CF API policy - structurally impossible. It still has connect/total timeouts.
auditConclusions.newFinding: A18: the Modrinth side has NO rate-limit/concurrency policy at all, while 7 egress points exist (ModContentService 3, ModrinthModpackService 2, ResourceContentService 2). CurseForge has a policy; Modrinth does not - the same class of operation is protected on one source and not the other.

redBaselines.red1: insert a CF API request that bypasses the policy -> EveryCurseForgeApiRequest_IsWrappedByTheRequestPolicy fails
redBaselines.red2: give ContentIconService a Modrinth API literal -> ContentIconService_MustNotCallTheModApis fails

selfFoundIssue: First run: 5 passed / 1 failed. The Modrinth counter reported 9 while I had recorded 10, because my "exclude const declarations" rule only recognised the name ModrinthApi - the other two files call their constant Api, so 2 declarations were miscounted as egress points. The true number of egress points is 7. Fixed by excluding ANY line containing "const string" and recording 7.
